_what: The column rights tool:keep-a-newsletter-signup needs from a pursuit's writer login (run-sql-in-my-database role recipe may-write-named-columns-under-a-use, recipe.writes): what it reads to decide, what a signup adds, and what a confirm, unsubscribe, renewal or failed mail changes. Nothing else of the database. test/keep-a-newsletter-signup.test.ts runs every action as a login holding exactly these.
